sources.snippet: SkillJev is a University of Toronto MScAC AI team research project developed in collaboration with TrendAI. We build SkillJev-2B, a lightweight scorer for malicious AI-agent skills, using OpenJev 2B, LoRA and a trainable classification head. The model returns a score for a fixed hypothesis: This AI agent skill is malicious.
